snippet.title: Little Cities: Diorama Apple Vision Pro Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Little Cities: Diorama is now available on Apple Vision Pro through Apple Arcade, bringing the critically acclaimed city creation series to mixed reality for the first time.

A collaboration between Little Cities' developer Purple Yonder and Near Light: an nDreams Studio, Little Cities: Diorama empowers you to create a bustling mini-metropolis and place it directly into your world.

----
💜 Available now on Apple Arcade
----
🏗️Developed by Purple Yonder and Near Light: an nDreams Studio
💻 Website - https://www.purpleyonder.com/
---
🧰Published by nDreams
💻 Website - http://ndreams.com/games/little-cities
----
